content.text: Bruin returns to Toto and his grandmother, settling happily into their cottage. In Annapolis, Croyden and Macloud pursue Parmenter’s treasure on Greenberry Point, recover the stolen letter, obtain a camping permit, confront thieves, and eventually discover the jewels hidden in Clarendon’s cellar. Croyden reconciles with Elaine Cavendish, while Macloud courts Miss Carrington. Elaine and Davila are abducted to a Bay-side house, but secure release through Elaine’s check. Separately, Allan Cameron and Mandy rescue an injured Piegan boy; Cameron later hunts Chief Onawata/Copperhead amid rising unrest. Moira travels to Calgary, meets Dr. Martin, and rides up the Bow. Raven rescues her runaway wagon team. Neighbors rebuild the Camerons’ burned ranch house, while Smith’s identity remains mysterious.
